content_of_post_to_answer: What's the first thing you usually do when you wake up: pray, check your phone, drink water, or get straight to work?
answer: I try to avoid checking my phone first. The moment you read a message or headline, your attention starts responding to someone else's priorities before you've even considered your own. A few quiet minutes, a glass of water, or even just sitting up without reaching for a screen can make the morning feel less reactive. I explore this habit and its effects further on my Quora profile, because the first thing we give our attention to often shapes what gets the rest of it.
